transcript: Khatoon, 55 saal. Aaj BP 160 aur 100 aaya hai. Sar bhaari rehta hai, chakkar nahi aate. Seene mein dard nahi hai. Norvasc 5 raat ko ek goli shuru kar di hai. Namak kam karna hai. Do hafte baad BP dobara check karwayein.

medications.name: Norvasc
medications.instructions: Start taking one tablet at night

advice: Get BP checked again after two weeks
